meta.claim: defendant C (control): CLOSED and ESTABLISHED -- a connection's starting state and its main working state -- could be swapped
meta.why_it_looks_legal: nothing -- this defendant exists as the obviously-refused control: a sanity check that all three parties (wuxing-gua relabel, wuxing-gua fixed, networkx) refuse together
meta.why_it_is_not_a_symmetry: CLOSED has 2 outgoing edges, ESTABLISHED has 2, but their in/out neighborhoods are entirely different (CLOSED is entered from LISTEN/LAST-ACK/TIME-WAIT; ESTABLISHED from SYN-SENT/SYN-RECEIVED); degree signatures already differ
